articles.title: Your Laugh Is a 15-Million-Year-Old Secret Code!
articles.summary: Scientists found that human laughter shares a hidden rhythm with gorillas, chimps, and orangutans. This beat has stayed the same for 15 million years, giving clues about how speech began.

articles.title: A Tiny Black Hole Could Unlock the Universe's Biggest Mystery!
articles.summary: Scientists think a strange signal from space might be a primordial black hole—a type of black hole born right after the Big Bang. If real, it could explain dark matter, the invisible stuff holding galaxies together.

articles.title: These Planets Are Fluffier Than Cotton Candy!
articles.summary: Astronomers found two giant planets that are lighter than cotton candy. Called TOI-791 b and c, they're as big as Jupiter but 30 times less dense. Citizen scientists helped spot them 1,110 light-years away.
